questions.text: Which one of the following is a closed form expression for the generating function of the sequence [latex]\left \{ a_{n} \right \}[/latex], where [latex]a_{n}=2n+3[/latex] for all n = 0, 1, 2,...?
questions.solution:
[latex]\sum(2n+3)x^n=2\sum nx^n+3\sum x^n=\frac{2x}{(1-x)^2}+\frac{3}{1-x}=\frac{2x+3(1-x)}{(1-x)^2}=\frac{3-x}{(1-x)^2}[/latex]

Answer: [latex]\frac{3-x}{(1-x)^2}[/latex]

questions.text: Using Newton-Raphson method, a root correct to 3 decimal places of  [latex]x^{3}-3 x-5=0[/latex]
questions.solution:
Newton-Raphson: [latex]x_{n+1}=x_n-\frac{x_n^3-3x_n-5}{3x_n^2-3}[/latex]. Starting near 2 (f(2) = [latex]-[/latex]3, f(3) = 13):
- [latex]x_1=2-\frac{-3}{9}\approx2.333[/latex]
- [latex]x_2\approx2.280[/latex], [latex]x_3\approx2.279[/latex] (stable)

Check: [latex]2.279^3-3(2.279)-5\approx0[/latex].

Answer: 2.279

questions.text:
If the characteristics polynomial of 3x3 matrix M over R ( the set of real numbers) is
[latex]\lambda ^{3}-4\lambda ^{2}+a\lambda +30,a\in R[/latex], and one eigenvalue of M is 2, then the largest among the absolute values of the eigenvalues of M is ________.
questions.solution:
2 is a root: [latex]8-16+2a+30=0\Rightarrow a=-11[/latex].
[latex]\lambda^3-4\lambda^2-11\lambda+30=(\lambda-2)(\lambda-5)(\lambda+3)[/latex] [latex]\rightarrow[/latex] eigenvalues 2, 5, [latex]-[/latex]3.

Largest absolute value = 5

Answer: 5

questions.text: If a random variable X has a Poisson distribution with mean 5, then the expectation [latex]E[(X+2)^{2}][/latex] equals ______________.
questions.solution:
For Poisson, mean = variance = 5, so [latex]E[X^2]=5+25=30[/latex].

[latex]E[(X+2)^2]=E[X^2]+4E[X]+4=30+20+4=54[/latex]

Answer: 54
